# 2 Baruch Chapter 79 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "And do not be troubled concerning the things that have befallen you, that the enemy has prevailed over you; for you were visited with chastisement on account of your sins."

**2** "But if you will turn from your evil ways and amend your deeds, you will be delivered again by the hand of the Mighty One."

**3** "For he is merciful, whom you have hoped in; and he is good to those who turn to him; and he is a witness to all his deeds, and he will judge every one of his creatures in righteousness."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
